_comment: TESTNET short-dated listing written for scripts/testnet-markets.sh, which fills settlement.primary.feed with the TestnetPushFeed it deploys (a Chainlink-compatible feed the keeper updates from Pyth every 5 minutes; testnet Chainlink has no MON/USD feed and updates ETH/USD too rarely for 1-6 h expiries). Settlement through it trusts the keeper: testnet only. asset = Kuru's testnet USDC 0x3bA3...1570 (6 decimals; docs.kuru.io), so every option can have a Kuru book. strikeStepWad and contractSizeWad are read by script/testnet/RollShortSeries.s.sol. underlying = WETH 0x4547...A2D7 (symbol WETH on Monad testnet) (monad-crypto testnet token list), an identifier only: options are cash-settled in USDC.
